metadata.title: SE3002 Surviving Mutant Academic Analysis
metadata.rubric_requirement: Analyse at least 15 surviving mutants (equivalent, missing test or weak assertion) and kill the killable ones
metadata.author: Sohaib (24i-3108)

surviving_mutants.root_cause_analysis: Pretix models.Quota.size is an unsigned PositiveIntegerField(null=True); negative q.size cannot exist in valid domain inputs, so q.size == 0 <=> q.size <= 0.
surviving_mutants.resolution: No test needed — formally equivalent under pretix domain invariants.
